blocks.text: MESO FAT เคล็ดลับหน้าเรียว

items: Meso Fat คือ นวัตกรรมสลายไขมันโดยการฉีดยาบางกลุ่มเข้าไปในชั้นผิวหนัง เพื่อสลายไขมันบริเวณนั้นๆ และขับออกมาทางปัสสาวะ รวมถึงทำให้เนื้อเยื่อกระชับ และแข็งแรงขึ้น
ผู้เข้ารับบริการส่วนมากมักฉีด Meso Fat บริเวณแก้ม และคาง เพื่อให้ใบหน้าเรียวสวยมากขึ้น และมักนิยมฉีดร่วมกับการฉีดโบท็อกซ์ เพื่อให้ใบหน้าดูกระชับยิ่งขึ้นไปอีก
หลังจากฉีด Meso Fat ผู้เข้ารับบริการควรดื่มน้ำมากๆ เพื่อขับไขมันที่สลายออกไปจากร่างกายให้มาก และเร็วที่สุด รวมถึงการงดอาหารที่มีไขมัน และน้ำตาลสูง เพื่อให้ไขมันใต้ผิวหนังไม่กลับมามีส่วนเกินเหมือนเดิม
ก่อนจะฉีด คุณต้องศึกษาการฉีดสาร Meso Fat ว่าเป็นอย่างไร และควรเลือกรับบริการกับแพทย์ผู้เชี่ยวชาญด้วย เพื่อความปลอดภัย และได้กำจัดไขมันส่วนเกินตามที่ต้องการอย่างเหมาะสม

en.title: What Are Meso Fat Injections and What Can They Do?
en.metaTitle: What Are Meso Fat Injections and What Can They Do?
en.metaDesc: Meso fat injections work by using medication to break down fat cells, which are then eliminated through the excretory system, reducing fat in the treated area.
en.lead: Meso fat is an injection of fat-dissolving agents targeted at specific spots of excess fat. It is commonly used to slim the cheeks, double chin, upper arms, thighs, hips and other areas where fat tends to accumulate.

blocks.alt: What are meso fat injections and what can they do?

blocks.html: Meso fat injections work by using medication that causes fat cells to break apart or dissolve. The fat is then eliminated from the body through the excretory system, reducing fat in the treated area.
Substances commonly used in meso fat injections include:

items: L-Carnitine — helps convert fat cells into energy and dissolves excess fat under the skin
Deoxycholic Acid — helps break down fat
Soybean Extract — helps stimulate fat metabolism

blocks.html: The advantages of meso fat injections are:

Meso fat injections remove excess fat and reshape the face or body into better proportions quickly. They are ideal for healthy individuals who cannot reduce fat by other means, or those who want a slimmer facial contour within a limited time.

items: Faster results than liposuction — full results appear in about 1-3 weeks
No surgery required
Less painful than liposuction

blocks.html: However, meso fat injections do carry some risks, such as:

items: Possible mild redness and swelling at the needle sites
Possible soreness in the injected area
Possible bruising in the injected area

blocks.text: MESO FAT: The Secret to a Slimmer Face

items: Meso Fat is a fat-dissolving innovation in which certain medications are injected into the skin layer to dissolve fat in that area and excrete it through the urine, while also firming and strengthening the tissue.
Most clients have Meso Fat injected in the cheeks and chin for a slimmer, more beautiful face, and it is often combined with Botox injections to make the face look even firmer.

After a Meso Fat treatment, clients should drink plenty of water to flush the dissolved fat out of the body as quickly as possible, and avoid high-fat, high-sugar foods so that excess fat under the skin does not return.
Before getting injections, you should study how Meso Fat works and choose a specialist doctor for the treatment, to stay safe and remove excess fat exactly where you want, in the right way.

blocks.html: People who should avoid meso fat injections include:

items: Diabetic patients who regularly use insulin
Patients with vascular or circulatory conditions such as ischemic stroke or cerebral thrombosis, and patients taking anticoagulant medication
Cancer patients who require extensive medication
Pregnant women
Anyone under 20 years of age

blocks.text: How Much Do Meso Fat Injections Cost?

blocks.html: The price of meso fat injections depends on the brand and the amount of fat to be dissolved. It generally ranges from 2,000-5,000 baht per cc.

blocks.text: Which Meso Fat Brand Should You Choose?

blocks.html: Choosing the right meso fat brand depends on several factors, including:

items: The area to be treated — for facial fat such as the cheeks or double chin, choose a brand containing Deoxycholic Acid to help break down fat
The amount of fat to be dissolved — for larger volumes of fat, choose a brand containing Soybean Extract to help stimulate fat metabolism
Skin condition — if you have sensitive skin, choose a gentle brand that does not cause irritation

blocks.html: Popular meso fat brands in Thailand include:

items: Phytobella — made from a range of natural extracts; dissolves fat and firms the skin without causing sagging, though it may sting slightly during injection
BABI Neo One — dissolves fat and lifts the skin; suitable for those with sagging cheeks, with only minimal stinging
FNC — dissolves fat effectively; suitable for those with fuller cheeks, with moderate stinging

blocks.html: There are also many other meso fat brands such as Filorga, Neobella and Noble. To choose the right one, consult a doctor or specialist for advice.
Here are some recommendations for choosing a meso fat brand:

items: Choose a brand certified by the Thai Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
Choose a brand suited to your skin condition and the area to be treated
Choose a brand that is effective and safe
Choose a brand whose price fits your budget

blocks.text: How Many Days Until You See Results After Meso Fat?

blocks.html: Results begin to show within 5-7 days after a meso fat injection, with about 10-15% of the fat dissolving after the first session. For more noticeable results, 2-3 repeat sessions may be needed, with full results within 2-3 weeks.
Meso fat results vary from person to person, depending on factors such as the amount of fat to be dissolved, skin condition and post-treatment care.
Here are self-care tips after meso fat injections to get the best results and prevent side effects:

items: Avoid alcohol and smoking
Drink plenty of water
Eat nutritious food and avoid high-fat meals
Exercise regularly

blocks.text: Is Meso Fat Worth It? What Precautions Should You Take?

blocks.html: This procedure is a good option for anyone who wants to reduce targeted excess fat without surgery. However, it is important to consult a doctor or specialist to assess your physical condition and choose the right brand before deciding to have the injections.
The advantages of meso fat injections include:

items: Faster results than liposuction — full results appear in about 1-3 weeks
No surgery required
Less painful than liposuction
Ideal for those with targeted pockets of excess fat

blocks.html: The drawbacks of meso fat injections include:

items: Possible mild redness and swelling at the needle sites
Possible soreness in the injected area
Possible bruising in the injected area
Results may be subtle — for clearer results, 2-3 repeat sessions may be needed

blocks.html: Results vary from person to person, depending on factors such as the amount of fat to be dissolved, skin condition and post-treatment care.
Precautions for meso fat injections include:

items: Only consult an experienced doctor or specialist
Make sure the meso fat brand is certified by the Thai Food and Drug Administration (FDA)
Research the different brands thoroughly before deciding to have the injections
Inform your doctor of your health history and any allergies
Strictly follow your doctor's instructions after the injections

blocks.html: If any unusual symptoms occur — such as redness and swelling, pain at the injection site, or fever — see a doctor immediately.
